Make presence absence chart with genus data
```{r}
# Start with a clean slate
rm(list=ls())

library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(pheatmap)

genus_mw_score <- read.delim("F:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/metabolic_output/bestrun_genus/MW-score_result.txt",
                       header = TRUE, sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE)

presence_absence <- genus_mw_score %>%
  select(-`MW-score for each function`) %>%   # drop MW-score column
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Function,
    names_to = "Genus",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Function = sub("^[^:]+:", "", Function),   # remove everything before first colon
    Presence = ifelse(Value > 0, 1, 0)
  )

# Now plot
full_plot <- ggplot(presence_absence, aes(x = Function, y = Genus, fill = factor(Presence))) +
  geom_tile(color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = "white", "1" = "black")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

```


Combine similar functions
```{r}

# Define dictionary for cycle assignment
cycle_lookup <- c(
  # Carbon cycle
  "Carbon fixation" = "Carbon",
  "Fermentation" = "Carbon",
  "Organic carbon oxidation" = "Carbon",
  "Methanotrophy" = "Carbon",
  "Hydrogen generation" = "Carbon",
  "Ethanol oxidation" = "Carbon",
  "Acetate oxidation" = "Carbon",
  "Hydrogen oxidation" = "Carbon",
  
  # Nitrogen cycle
  "Nitrate reduction" = "Nitrogen",
  "Nitrite reduction" = "Nitrogen",
  "Nitric oxide reduction" = "Nitrogen",
  "Nitrous oxide reduction" = "Nitrogen",
  "Nitrite ammonification" = "Nitrogen",
  
  # Sulfur cycle
  "Sulfate reduction" = "Sulfur",
  "Sulfide oxidation" = "Sulfur",
  "Sulfite oxidation" = "Sulfur",
  "Sulfur oxidation" = "Sulfur",
  "Thiosulfate oxidation" = "Sulfur",
  "Thiosulfate disproportionation" = "Sulfur",
  
  # Other
  "Arsenite oxidation" = "Other",
  "Iron oxidation" = "Other",
  "Iron reduction" = "Other"
)

#some functions are broken down into more specific parts like nitrate reduction and carbon fixation, we are gonna put those back together
presence_absence_grouped <- presence_absence %>%
  mutate(
    # remove everything after a "(" and trim whitespace
    Function_clean = str_replace(Function, "\\s*\\(.*\\)", "") %>% str_trim(),
    # now collapse subfunctions by taking only the text before "-"
    Function_group = str_extract(Function_clean, "^[^\\-]+") %>% str_trim(),
    # remove trailing colon if present
    Function_group = str_replace(Function_group, ":$", "")
  ) %>%
  group_by(Function_group, Genus) %>%
  summarise(Presence = as.numeric(any(Presence == 1)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  # assign cycle categories
  mutate(
   Cycle = cycle_lookup[Function_group]
  )

# Order Function_group by cycle priority
presence_absence_grouped <- presence_absence_grouped %>%
  mutate(
    Cycle = factor(Cycle, levels = c("Carbon", "Nitrogen", "Sulfur", "Other")),
    Function_group = factor(Function_group,
                            levels = unique(Function_group[order(Cycle)]))
  )

clean_plot <- ggplot(presence_absence_grouped,
                     aes(x = Function_group, y = Genus)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = interaction(Presence, Cycle)), color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "0.Carbon"   = "white",
      "0.Nitrogen" = "white",
      "0.Sulfur"   = "white",
      "0.Other"    = "white",
      "1.Carbon"   = "#A6CAEC",  
      "1.Nitrogen" = "#B4E5A2",  # Green, Accent 6, Lighter 60%
      "1.Sulfur"   = "#F5E677",
      "1.Other"    = "#F6C6AD"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title  = element_blank()
  )

png("F:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/manuscript_figures/cycles_presence_absence/presence_absence_plot.png", width = 3000, height = 2000, res = 300)
print(clean_plot)
dev.off()

pdf("F:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/manuscript_figures/cycles_presence_absence/presence_absence_plot.pdf",
    width = 12,  # width in inches
    height = 8)  # height in inches
print(clean_plot)
dev.off()

```
